text: Kofi - knee op @ St Thomas's 14 Nov. off work 6 wks min. text him the day before
Gareth's dad passed Sat. funeral prob next Thurs, Welsh chapel nr Bala. card + flowers - sort tmrw
Marisol made redundant w/ half the design team. last day Nov 28th. v calm abt it, says she saw it coming
Keisha - new line manager Ilse, ex-Deloitte, v strict on timesheets. K not a fan
Rana Banerjee (Ree) back from hosp after gallbladder. home since 3/10. sore but ok, eating plain stuff only

Ben + Asha split up. been coming a while apparently - rows since the summer, then she took the job in Manchester w/o asking him. he's staying at his brother Aneesh's for now, sofa. not eating properly, losing weight. Aneesh worried too. his birthday's Nov 9th, poor timing. check on him next wk, maybe dinner Sat
Thabo - client pitch to Nguyen Holdings Oct 30th, petrified. wish him luck morning of
dentist 2pm Weds, 22/10. bring the form
Ibrahim's mum - hip replacement 5th of Dec. he's taking a wk off to look after her. ask how she's getting on after
Ahmed leaving drinks cancelled - he's not leaving after all, counter offer. stays as team lead

Long call w/ Marisol. Redundancy officially confirmed 3rd of Nov, last day now 28 Nov not Dec. pay-out ok, 3 months. she's interviewing @ Spotify (Fri 7 Nov) + a small agency in Shoreditch the wk after. her partner Thabo being v supportive, he's taking her to Lisbon in Dec to reset. I should send her the Garcia contact Matilda mentioned + check in after Spotify
Demi: biopsy results due Nov 3. nervous wreck. don't forget to call her that eve
Arjun - boss Mr Rossi retiring end of Dec. A might go for his role. interviews Jan

Amy's grandad died last wk, 94. funeral was today, small one at the crem, then sandwiches at her aunt's. she seemed ok-ish, mostly tired. he basically raised her til she was 8 so it's bigger than she lets on. her mum not coping well. Amy off rest of the wk, back Mon 27th
Laila - cat Biscuit had op on tummy, swallowed a hair tie. home now, cone of shame. Laila v relieved
Phoebe started @ the Royal Free Mon as ward sister. loves it so far but 12hr shifts brutal
call Kalani re: her mri - should've had results by now (scan was Oct 8th)
Reggie & Joy - 25th anniv Sat 15 Nov, dinner @ Rossi's. Joy hinting abt a weekend in Bath. maybe chip in w/ Marcus?
Marcus - performance review moved to Nov 12. thinks they're building a case. stressed. need to take him for a pint before
Dafydd broke up w/ Mila. she ended it, out of nowhere. he's gutted, not sleeping
Femi - surgery for the slipped disc finally booked: Jan 9th. off 3 months. he's relieved tbh
Amara - mum's chemo starts 11/4. A juggling work + hospital runs. offer lifts? ask what she needs
Matilda Osei - new client contact @ Garcia & Co. v sharp, vegan, hates calls b4 10. lunch w/ her 2 Dec
Haruto - wife Mila expecting! due late March. he's thrilled, also panicking abt paternity leave
Helen Dubois got the promo to head of ops. starts officially Jan 6th. send congrats
Joy - hospital stay extended, infection after the op. now prob home 24th. Reggie running himself ragged. must drop food round Fri
Gareth (Gaz) - still off w/ stress. HR call Tues 28/10. he asked me to sit in, said yes
ivan - appendix out, emergency, sun night. in Whittington, ward 4. visiting hrs 2-8. pop in thurs aft w/ grapes
Kofi & his wife Ama - moving to Leeds in Feb, his new job @ NHS Digital starts Feb 2nd. sad to lose him
Alejandro's dog Coco put to sleep yesterday, 15 yrs old. he's in bits. send a card

Phoebe update - dad's op moved to Jan 22nd. Arjun can't get leave til the 20th, so Phoebe going in alone first. she's brave abt it but def scared. their mum Joy staying in the hosp hotel. Amy (Phoebe's flatmate) feeding her cat Pickle. ring P the night before + send something to the ward after
Marisol interview @ Spotify Fri 7th Nov, 2nd round. prep call w/ her Weds night
Asha's sister Rana getting married 21/06 in Lahore. Asha flying out a wk early
Keisha - Q4 targets missed, whole team on PIP watch. she's anxious, applying elsewhere quietly. ask how apps going in a couple wks
Ben - first day back after the breakup. quiet but ok. coffee @ 11 tmrw, my shout
Ilse - allergic to nuts, serious (epipen). remember for team xmas do Dec 18
Aneesh - father's funeral Mon 27 Oct, Hindu ceremony @ Golders Green. wear white. Aneesh asked if I'd say a few words... I said yes. need to write sth by Sun
Thabo pitch went well! Nguyen Holdings signed. ask him abt the bonus convo w/ boss next wk
Ibrahim - mum's hip op postponed, now Jan 15. he'd already booked the time off. annoying for him
Ahmed + Laila - housewarming 8 Nov, new flat in Walthamstow. bring wine, not red (Laila)
Demi - all clear!! benign. take her out to celebrate, she mentioned the Thai place on Upper St
Arjun's sister Phoebe - kidney donor match for their dad. op mid Jan, both in hosp ~1 wk. Arjun stressed abt both of them. ring him wk of 12th
Amy - redundancy consultation Thurs 30th, 9:30am. 3 of 8 roles going. she's sure it's her. text her after
Kalani - mri clear, just a sprain. physio 2x wk from Nov 4th. back to netball by Feb hopefully
car MOT 11/18, garage on Holloway Rd. also renew parking permit before Dec 1

Reggie's brother Dafydd in hosp - heart attack Sun. stable now, stent fitted, consultant says he was lucky. Reggie driving up to Cardiff tmrw, back Weds, covering his clients Thurs + Fri. Dafydd's wife Kalani + the kids staying w/ her parents. ask after Dafydd when Reggie's back, and let Femi know re: Thurs meeting
Marcus - review done, kept on but final warning. not great. he's applying for Haruto's old job at Rossi Partners. I should send him the job link Haruto forwarded

Femi - mentioned he collects vinyl, mostly 70s afrobeat, has ~2000. Fela first pressings = holy grail, he lost out on one on ebay last month and is still sore. birthday Mar 3rd fyi. also plays bass in a covers band w/ Kofi, gig at the Hope & Anchor 6 Dec, said I'd go
Mila - starts maternity leave 28/2. team collection for a gift - sort w/ Helen
Joy home finally. walking w/ a frame. Reggie says she's v low, fed up. call her Sun, just to chat

Office stuff from Helen: Rossi retiring 19 Dec, his job ad going up Nov 10. Arjun + Marcus both applying, awkward. client Matilda Nowak escalated over the late invoices, meeting w/ her Tues 4th. Gareth still off. Haruto's last day Nov 14. lot going on. don't forget Helen's own bday Nov 26th - she wants that orange Le Creuset
Amara's mum - chemo round 2 Dec 2nd. mum coping, A not so much. remind me to send meal voucher thing

Matilda - contract renewal meeting Nov 19th, lots riding on it, her board wants 15% off or they walk. she's been great fighting our corner. new baby at home too (Rosa, 4 months) so v little sleep. follow-up 21/11 w/ her + Ivan to go thru numbers. maybe flowers after if it goes thru
Haruto's leaving do Fri 14/11 @ the Lamb. he's off to Garcia & Co. I'm doing the card, collect £ by Weds
Helen - her husband Ibrahim's knee surgery went fine, 17th Oct. home already. she says he's a terrible patient lol

Gaz - signed off another 4 wks. back maybe Dec 1st, phased return. sounded flat on the phone, says the meds are helping a bit. his wife Demi has taken over all the school runs. the Banerjee account is his - who covers? raise w/ Helen Mon. also need to send him the get well hamper from the team
ivan home from hosp. stitches out Nov 6. bored silly. lend him the switch
Keisha got the job!! @ Osei Partners, starts Jan 5. handing notice in Mon. drinks to celebrate b4 xmas
Ben's ex Asha still emailing re: shared flat. messy. he has to be out by Dec 31st. help w/ boxes the wknd b4?
Alejandro - mum's 70th Nov 23rd. big family thing in Madrid, he's flying out 21st, back 25th. ask how it went
